<div className="inline-flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2">
  <Badge color="gray">GET</Badge>
  `https://sys.poixe.com/api/vendor/earnings`
</div>

Retrieve the vendor earnings summary for the current account, including total earnings, settled amount, pending amount, and supply statistics.

## Response Fields

<ResponseField name="tier" type="integer">
  Vendor tier
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="earnings" type="object">
  Earnings summary:

  <Expandable title="earnings fields">
    <ResponseField name="total_earnings" type="number">
      Cumulative total earnings in USD, rounded to 3 decimal places
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="paid_cash" type="number">
      Settled amount in USD
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="unpaid_cash" type="number">
      Pending settlement amount in USD
    </ResponseField>
  </Expandable>
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="supply" type="object">
  Supply statistics:

  <Expandable title="supply fields">
    <ResponseField name="provided_quota" type="number">
      Cumulative quota provided in USD
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="request_count" type="integer">
      Cumulative number of requests served
    </ResponseField>
  </Expandable>
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="timestamp" type="integer">
  Response timestamp (Unix seconds)
</ResponseField>
